Sea Area Bulletin
Bulletin Valid for 12 hrs from 21 UTC of 2026-10-04 to 09 UTC of 2026-10-05
 
TTT Warning NIL
 
Synoptic Situation
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south coastal
Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists. The trough from above
cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south coastal Tamil Nadu to
Eastcentral Arabian Sea across interior Tamil Nadu and north Kerala at 0.9 km
above mean sea level persists. Southwest monsoon weak to moderate over entire
Arabian sea to the south of latitude 17.5 Deg N . Weather seasonal over Arabian sea
to the north of latitude 17.5 deg N.
